comment: The ArtCraft edition of Mihawk OS: its own PS5 title beside Mihawk OS, sharing nothing with it.

title.name: ArtCraft
title.comment: A tile and a data folder of ArtCraft's own: Mihawk OS keeps PPSA99170 and /data/ps5proton, untouched. 99278 is ART on a phone keypad, in the 99xxx range homebrew uses, apart from Mihawk's titles (99008, 99130, 99170). Patch 0007 (artcraft_ps5/identity.py) gives the fork's title, runtime and tools these values.

profile.name: ArtCraft
profile.detail: The Craft App Suite on a desktop of its own
